title: 第11章 有腹肌了，三个控制系
slug: 斗罗冬儿重生我不是唐舞桐
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

王冬儿与霍雨浩同吃、同住，一起学习，一起战斗，开心地度过了三个月。

霍雨浩发现，自己每次和王冬儿待在一起时都感觉很舒服。有些时候与她眼神对视，自己的心就会砰砰地跳，他想着自己是不是生病了。

萧萧在这三个月里全程旁观他们的生活，偷偷写下了一本叫做《两个男同学的观察日记》的书。

三个月后，王冬儿和霍雨浩都发生了极大的变化。

尤其是霍雨浩。之前的他比王冬儿还要矮一些，而现在他们两个已经差不多高了。

王冬儿也能感受到霍雨浩的身体变得结实了许多，之前霍雨浩换衣服的时候，她都看到霍雨浩已经有很明显的腹肌了。

当然，这也多亏了王冬儿这几个月不断投喂霍雨浩。

他以前吃的实在太差，有些发育不良。现在营养足够，再加上周漪那种有些变态的锻炼，他的身体素质已经追上了其他人。

王冬儿的变化主要是在魂力的修炼上。

不知道是不是重生的缘故，她的精神力比前世同一时期强大许多，所以修行速度也变得更快了。

这三个月里，王冬儿查遍了史莱克外院所有她可以看到的书籍，希望可以找到让自己变强大的办法。

可惜外院这些书虽然很多都是孤本，却并没有她想要的。

王冬儿想着之后进海神阁后，能不能找机会去看一下里面的藏书，或许能够找到一些线索。

“雨浩，下课了，走，我们去食堂吃饭。”

王冬儿迫不及待地就要拉着霍雨浩走。

而这时，周漪走进教室，拦住了所有人。

“耽误大家几分钟时间，我讲一件很重要的事情。”

王冬儿瘪了瘪嘴，只好重新坐下。

“今天下午的体能课暂停。”

班上的学生们并没有什么反应，但仔细看的话就能发现，他们眉头微微上扬。

虽然他们也知道体能课对自身的实力增长很重要，但能少上一天，还是觉得很舒服的。

“你们也别高兴得太早。开学到现在已经三个月了，你们将会迎来第一次新生考核。只有考核通过的人才能够真正成为史莱克的一员，没通过的人只能回家。这是学院的决定，投诉我也没用。”

说到这里，周漪下意识地看了王冬儿一眼。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Wang Donger and Huo Yuhao ate and lived together, studied together, fought together, and spent three months happily.

Huo Yuhao found that he felt very comfortable every time he stayed with Wang Donger.Sometimes when he looked into her eyes, his heart would beat loudly, and he wondered if he was sick.

Xiao Xiao watched their lives throughout the past three months and secretly wrote a book called "Observation Diary of Two Male Classmates".

Three months later, both Wang Donger and Huo Yuhao had undergone great changes.

Especially Huo Yuhao.He was shorter than Wang Dong'er before, but now they are almost tall.

Wang Dong'er could also feel that Huo Yuhao's body had become much stronger. When Huo Yuhao changed clothes before, she saw that Huo Yuhao already had obvious abdominal muscles.

Of course, this is also thanks to Wang Donger's constant feeding of Huo Yuhao in the past few months.

He used to eat really poorly and was somewhat stunted.Now that he has enough nutrition, coupled with Zhou Yi's somewhat abnormal exercise, his physical fitness has caught up with others.

Wang Donger's changes were mainly in the cultivation of soul power.

I don't know if it's because of her rebirth, but her mental power is much stronger than at the same time in her previous life, so her cultivation speed has become faster.

In the past three months, Wang Dong'er checked all the books she could read in Shrek's outer courtyard, hoping to find a way to make herself stronger.

Unfortunately, although many of the books in the outer courtyard were single copies, they did not have what she wanted.

Wang Donger wondered if she could find a chance to look at the books inside after entering the Poseidon Pavilion, and maybe find some clues.

"Yuhao, get out of class is over, let's go, let's go to the cafeteria to eat."

Wang Donger couldn't wait to pull Huo Yuhao away.

At this time, Zhou Yi walked into the classroom and stopped everyone.

"I will spare everyone a few minutes to talk about something very important."

Wang Donger pursed his lips and had to sit down again.

"The physical fitness class is suspended this afternoon."

The students in the class didn't react much, but if you look carefully, you can see that their brows are slightly raised.

Although they also know that physical fitness classes are important for their own strength growth, they still feel very comfortable if they can skip one day.

"Don't be too happy too early. It has been three months since the school started, and you will face the first freshman assessment. Only those who pass the assessment can truly become a member of Shrek, and those who fail can only go home. This is the college's decision, and there is no point in complaining to me."

Speaking of this, Zhou Yi glanced at Wang Donger subconsciously.
